selection_reason: Logistic Regression (baseline) had the highest validation ROC-AUC (0.864; ties broken by PR-AUC then recall). Selection never used test data. Decision threshold: highest threshold keeping validation recall >= 90% (validation specificity at this threshold = 0.730); chosen for screening where missed cases are costlier than false alarms.
threshold_rule: highest threshold keeping validation recall >= 90% (validation specificity at this threshold = 0.730); chosen for screening where missed cases are costlier than false alarms

global_explanation.note: Mean |SHAP| over a sample of the held-out test set. Importance shows what the model relies on, not causal effect.

attributes.note: Age bands (<40, 40-59, 60+) chosen for interpretability, not clinical cut-offs.

mitigation.note: Comparison only; the deployed model is unchanged. Mitigation may trade overall accuracy/recall for smaller gaps and uses randomised decisions, which may be unsuitable clinically.

findings: age_group: TPR gap 0.213, FPR gap 0.393, selection-rate gap 0.359 (reliable groups only).
limitations: Fairness metrics describe disparities on one held-out test set; small subgroups give wide, unstable estimates.
No single metric establishes fairness; demographic parity, equal opportunity and equalized odds can conflict.
Only attributes present in the data are audited (no ethnicity/socioeconomic data unless supplied); intersectional groups are not evaluated.
Calculating these metrics does not mean bias has been removed.

class_balance_method: class_weight / scale_pos_weight in training only (no resampling of validation/test)
calibration: Platt scaling fitted on the validation set
limitations: Single-source public dataset: no external or prospective validation; not clinically validated.
Test set has only 154 records (53 positive); 95% CI for recall is 0.64-0.87. Treat metrics as indicative only.
Test recall is 0.77: the model misses a notable share of positive cases and should not be used to rule out disease.

error_costs.false_negative: A missed case delays glucose management and raises long-term complication risk.
error_costs.false_positive: A false alarm leads to confirmatory testing (e.g. HbA1c).
